messages:
jordan-cs: Heads-up — Acacia Health hit a 401 after rotating their API key. They say they updated the k8s secret via our docs but the app started failing immediately with invalid_api_key.

maria-support: Ticket created (#SUP-2147). Can you paste the pipeline step they used to push the new key? asked customer for k8s secret manifest. :eyes:

jordan-cs: Paste from their CI job: `NEW_KEY=$(vault kv get -format=json secret/redwood)` then `kubectl create secret generic redwood --from-literal=API_KEY="$NEW_KEY" --namespace=prod` — they grabbed the full vault output instead of the scalar value.

ryan-engr: Repro'd locally. If you stash the whole JSON blob as the key we return 401 invalid_api_key (we validate token pattern/prefix). Example curl I used: 
```
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer {\"request\":\"...\"}" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```
Response: `HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized` with body `{"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"api key malformed or unknown"}`.

ryan-engr: Fix for them is to extract the scalar string from Vault. Two safe options we recommend:
```
# if using Vault kv v2 JSON output
vault kv get -format=json secret/redwood | jq -r .data.data.api_key
# or use the field flag if available
vault kv get -field=api_key secret/redwood
```
Then create the k8s secret with the scalar only: `kubectl create secret generic redwood --from-literal=API_KEY="$EXTRACTED_KEY" --namespace=prod` or to patch: `kubectl create secret generic redwood --from-literal=API_KEY="$EXTRACTED_KEY" -o yaml --dry-run=client | kubectl apply -f -`

maria-support: Also warned them about base64/newline gotchas when editing YAML by hand. If they base64-encode locally use `echo -n "$EXTRACTED_KEY" | base64` (no trailing newline).

eve-sre: Recommend rotating the compromised key and issuing a fresh one (we should revoke the JSON-stored key if they accidentally used the real rotated value). Also add a short pipeline lint: check that the key starts with `rwd_` and length ~36. If not, fail the deploy step.

jordan-cs: I sent the extraction command + k8s patch to Acacia and asked them to rotate and confirm. Follow-up: they said their app resumed after we walked them through extracting `jq -r .data.data.api_key` and applying the secret. :thumbsup:

ingest-bot: deploy-staging succeeded for acacia-health/fix-rotate (CI job 8421)

maria-support: Closing ticket once customer confirms prod is green. Will add a short support doc snippet about "Vault JSON vs field extraction" to reduce recurrence.

ryan-engr: Quick note for engineering docs: include example for both kv v1 and kv v2 outputs and a one-liner lint that checks `^rwd_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,50}$`.

jordan-cs: Thanks everyone — marking P1 resolved on our side, pending customer ack.
